description.value: Cindy's is a cozy neighborhood brunch café on Marine Drive in West Vancouver, earning a loyal following for Canadian comfort food such as Belgian waffles, eggs benedict, and creative omelets made with locally sourced ingredients. Despite its modest size, it has carved out a niche as a hidden gem with thoughtful service, special events, and a High Tea offering that sets it apart from typical breakfast spots. With a 4.3 Google rating across 425 reviews, it draws a steady crowd of regulars and visitors alike.
